pt.confirm_install_link: Vai instalar o endereço {domain}. Confirme se é isso mesmo.

pt.confirm_dry_add: Entra na lista da TV só este app. Os outros ficam como estão.

en.iptv_notice: Players use the list or subscription you already have. The Store does not suggest channels.
en.empty_tab: No apps in this tab yet.
en.installed_empty: You have not installed any app yet.
en.install_ok: Installed. You can open it now.
en.install_fail: Could not install {app}. Nothing changed on your TV.
en.open_fail: Could not open {app}. Use the {app} button on the remote.
en.shelf_no_path: Use the {app} button on the remote
en.remove_fail: Could not remove {app}. Nothing changed on your TV.
en.unplug_strip: Shows up in the TV menu after unplugging it.
en.offline: No internet right now. I will try again by myself.
en.no_catalog: The Store has not loaded yet. Wait a moment.
en.unsafe: Connection without protection. Use only on networks and addresses you trust.
en.confirm_install: This will install {app} from {domain}. Confirm that is right.
en.confirm_install_link: This will install the address {domain}. Confirm that is right.
en.confirm_typed: You typed this address. Check the site name before you go on.
en.confirm_dry_add: Only this app is added to the TV list. The others stay as they are.
en.confirm_dry_update: Updates the entry that already exists. The other apps stay as they are.
en.link_cta_sub: Type the address of a site you use
en.link_bad: That address does not look right. Check it and try again.
en.link_blocked: For safety, the Store only accepts sites from the approved list or addresses on your home network.
en.link_pc_only: The TV cannot save on its own right now. Add the link in the installer on the computer, which has a real keyboard.
en.queue_step1: Start the installer on the computer
en.queue_step1_sub: Open the installer and leave its window open. It shows the computer's address.
en.queue_step2: Point the TV's DNS at the computer
en.queue_step2_sub: In Settings, Network, switch DNS to manual and type the address shown.
en.queue_step3_sub: I will see if the computer answers before opening the installer.
en.queue_fail: I could not find the computer. Check the steps and try again.
en.dns_back: When you finish, set the TV's DNS back to automatic. Otherwise the TV has no internet if this computer is turned off.
